synopsis: “You’re less than garbage as a servant!” Gald, a boy working as a servant for an Earl’s family, is expelled one day. With nowhere to go, Gald decides to enroll in a magic academy, something he never did in his previous life. In his past life—Gald was the strongest sage in history! In the entrance examination for the world's most prestigious magic academy, Gald, a commoner, surpasses nobles who can only use intermediate-level magic, demonstrating mastery over the highest level of magic, overwhelming them! After enrolling, Gald continues to use his overwhelming power as a sage, defeating all enemies in the arena and dungeons alike, enjoying his academy life alongside two beautiful girls he met there, Yuri and Sasha.

synopsis: Due to a divine mistake, Sansui Shirokuro meets an untimely death. To make up for it, he’s sent to another world. He wishes to be fawned over in classic I’m OP fashion, but when he tells that to God, he somehow ends up training under the hermit Suiboku… Five hundred years later, when he’s become a full-fledged hermit, Sansui stumbles upon an abandoned baby. He names the child Rein and ventures into the world to raise her… Thus, the hermit with a baby begins his parenting. (Source: Manga Mirai)

synonyms: I, an Ordinary Guy with No Redeeming Qualities, Risked My Life to Save Beautiful Twin Sisters, Only to Make the Secretly Yandere Duo Fall Madly in Love with Me
synopsis: Yagami Ryoya, an ordinary high school boy with no particular redeeming qualities, saved the lives of the school's idol twin sisters from a violent thug. That was the beginning of their sweet yet abnormal "repayment"─. Reona and Riona close the distance, affirming his every move and spoiling him to the absolute limit. However, their love is a "yandere" obsession that goes way beyond just being "super heavy"...!? Dragging in his family, his environment, and everything else around him, the twin sisters completely seal off Ryoya's escape routes. They are undeniably cute, but there is nowhere to run. What will become of Ryoya's fate now that he is locked onto by a 100% pure desire for monopoly!? Packed with lovey-dovey moments! An unpredictable romantic comedy where the protagonist gets completely tossed around, officially begins!
